output.summary: KEP-3545 adds a kubelet option (topology-manager-policy-options, prefer-closest-numa-nodes) so the TopologyManager favors NUMA node sets with shorter distances when comparing equal-sized sets. It was implemented and graduated to stable, with status marked implemented from 2025-02-03.
output.rationale: Topology Manager policies align on a single NUMA node or the minimum number of nodes but ignore NUMA distance, which can cause performance loss when non-adjacent nodes are chosen. The design extends the manager with a policy option, following the CPUManager policy-options precedent, so that all policies can prefer closer NUMA nodes while preserving their other properties. The discussion shows the team chose this over a new policy because distance matters for both best-effort and restricted.

alternatives.option: Add a new Topology Manager policy similar to best-effort that also considers NUMA distance
alternatives.why_not: NUMA distance can be an important factor not only for best-effort but also restricted policy, so a mechanism similar to CPUManagerPolicyOptions that influences multiple policies was preferred.

alternatives.option: Obtain NUMA distances from cadvisor only, without a kubelet workaround
alternatives.why_not: cadvisor's distance change was merged on master but not in an official release by the time of review, so a temporary kubelet code path was kept until cadvisor is vendored (the KEP's temporary code path).

evidence.quote: The proposed enhancement is only applicable when comparing sets of NUMA nodes that are equal in size.
